entities.name: Scarwood
entities.description: A dangerous wood where exorcists are welcome and nothing may be left unguarded.

entities.name: Mairsil, called the Pretender
entities.description: A power whose weakening loosened Barl's Cage; also called the Pretender.

entities.name: Lord Ith
entities.description: A lord held in Barl's Cage for a dozen years.

entities.name: Barl's Cage
entities.description: A cage that held Lord Ith as long as Mairsil's power held.

entities.name: Maeveen O'Donagh
entities.description: Soldier and author of Memoirs of a Soldier.

entities.name: Vervamon the Elder
entities.description: A knowledge-seeking writer who describes wilderness hazards.

entities.name: Tivadar of Thorn
entities.description: Author of History of the Goblin Wars.

entities.name: Knights of Thorn
entities.description: Knights who broke the Goblin host in the Goblin Wars.

entities.name: Goblin Wars
entities.description: A war between Knights and Goblin clans.

entities.name: Lacjsi
entities.description: A speaker whose speech made the Knights determined to crush their enemies clan by clan.

entities.name: Tervish
entities.description: A man whose amulet vanished from his memory.

entities.name: Captain Soll
entities.description: A ship captain asked about the Serafina.

entities.name: Serafina
entities.description: A ship that went down.

entities.name: Raganorn
entities.description: A man who unsealed the catacombs and found more than the dead.

entities.name: Primata Delphine
entities.description: A figure in charge of an Inquisition whose charges screamed.

entities.name: Voska
entities.description: A person who feared an artifact had come too easily.

entities.name: Norin the Wary
entities.description: A cautious man who knew a Goblin Shrine wasn't an ordinary pile.

entities.name: Keevy Bogsbury
entities.description: Speaker about marsh gas.

entities.name: Ailheen
entities.description: Speaker of the Council who called for the Elves of Deep Shadow to be cast out.

entities.name: Elves of Deep Shadow
entities.description: Elves condemned as aberrations.

entities.name: Niall Silvain
entities.description: Ruler of a domain where one must value all life as one's own.

entities.name: Sidaine of Savaen
entities.description: A Savaen elf speaking about purity of magic and land.

entities.name: Savaen Elves
entities.description: Elves who tie purity of magic to purity of the land.

entities.name: Lady Ursnell
entities.description: Maker of the first bone flute after the Battle of Pitdown.

entities.name: Lord Ursnell
entities.description: Husband of Lady Ursnell, whose left leg became a flute.

entities.name: Battle of Pitdown
entities.description: A battle after which the first bone flute was made.

entities.name: Lydia, Countess Brellis
entities.description: A noblewoman who saw coal golems before a Fireball struck.

entities.name: Sevti Mukul
entities.description: Author of The Fall of Alsoor.

entities.name: Dark Lands
entities.description: Lands whose paths were charted on the Stone Calendar.

entities.name: Malga Phlegmtooth
entities.description: Orc speaker on fear in an army.

entities.name: Sister Betje
entities.description: Author of Miracles of the Saints.

events.summary: Tervish's amulet vanishes from his possession and his memory.
events.quote: It had disappeared not only from his possession, but from his memory as well.

events.summary: Captain Soll is asked what became of the Serafina and says ships that go down shouldn't come back up.
events.quote: Ships that go down shouldn't come back up.

events.summary: Raganorn unseals the catacombs and finds more than the dead and their treasures.
events.quote: When Raganorn unsealed the catacombs, he found more than the dead and their treasures.

events.summary: The Goblin host breaks and runs as the first wave of Knights penetrates its ranks.
events.quote: the Goblin host broke and ran as the first wave of Knights penetrated its ranks

events.summary: After Lacjsi's speech the Knights grow determined to crush their ancient enemies clan by clan.
events.quote: After Lacjsi's speech, the Knights grew determined to crush their ancient enemies clan by clan.

events.summary: Maeveen O'Donagh's troop hides pikes in the grass to face a cavalry charge.
events.quote: we faced them with swords drawn and pikes hidden in the grass at our feet

events.summary: Maeveen O'Donagh is made to stand helpless as his whole troop is killed.
events.quote: standing there helpless as they killed my whole troop

events.summary: Lord Ith's cage weakens as Mairsil's power wanes after a dozen years.
events.quote: For a dozen years the Cage had held Lord Ith, but as the Pretender Mairsil's power weakened, so did the bars.

events.summary: After the Battle of Pitdown, Lady Ursnell fashions the first bone flute from Lord Ursnell's left leg.
events.quote: Lady Ursnell fashioned the first such instrument out of Lord Ursnell's left leg.

events.summary: Mairsil orders a great Calendar drawn up to show when the paths to the Dark Lands were strongest.
events.quote: The Pretender Mairsil ordered a great Calendar drawn up to show when the paths to the Dark Lands were strongest.

events.summary: Coal golems burn atop a hill before a Fireball strikes the front line.
events.quote: Only seconds later, the Fireball struck our front line.

events.summary: The Elves of Deep Shadow are denounced by Ailheen and called to be cast out.
Vervamon the Elder's party is saved by strange floating lights showing the way.
events.quote: the strange, floating lights showed us the way and restored our morale

relations.quote: For a dozen years the Cage had held Lord Ith

relations.note: The Cage's bars weaken as his power weakens.
relations.quote: as the Pretender Mairsil's power weakened, so did the bars

relations.note: Lady Ursnell is Lord Ursnell's wife.
relations.quote: Lady Ursnell fashioned the first such instrument out of Lord Ursnell's left leg
After Lacjsi's speech, the Knights grew determined

relations.note: She calls for them to be cast out.
relations.quote: They are aberrations who have turned on everything we hold sacred.
